datePolicy: Preserve original November 7, 2026 access dates and source-specific effective/publication dates; authoring is not a fresh source check. Unknown publication/model dates remain unknown. 2026/27 pay, tax, pension and current test/visa fees may change before 2027; no award, immigration reform outcome or future clearance implementation is invented.
uncertainties: Philippine first-time UK/NHS deployment requirements and fees remain unconfirmed: DMW licensed-agency/accreditation or approved direct hire, MWO contract/addendum, orientations, medical, insurance/membership, OEC/digital exit clearance and any cohort quota/exemption need current confirmation. PRC NMC verification alone is not departure clearance.

No actual job offer, sponsor, CoS, pay-step recognition or repayment contract inspected. Funded model requires upfront OSCE/visa/flight and two months free accommodation. Later reimbursement is a cash-flow gap, not equivalent to prepayment. Mandatory sponsorship/recruitment costs are employer-only.

GBP1=PHP75 and stress80 are unconfirmed planning rates. Private costs and TB6000PHP reserve are allowances, not tariffs. Local IELTS14470PHP provider price and NHSBSA pension inputs are provisional under original publisher restriction. OET price unknown.

Current NMC/visa/English/assessment/deadline rules and all fees need recheck for 2027. Eligibility field, actual test dates, medical/character evidence and exam availability are individual. July–August arrival for September registered work is a buffer, not a guarantee.

Pay model uses England non-London 2026/27 rates, entry Band5 salary and pension; no overtime or remittances. Band4 pre-PIN pay is an offered-role assumption, not universal. NI annual-threshold approximation can differ by payroll pennies; future rates and emergency tax unknown.

September2027–August2028 higher net illustration assumes no earlier UK taxable income and full allowance across two tax years with unchanged current rates; residence and foreign income may change result. Do not spend the modelled benefit before actual payroll.

Family child age, eligibility/care arrangements, joining date, remaining grant duration, housing and childcare quote unknown. Family gross fund credits no returned room deposit; excludes childcare, renewal and settlement. One entry Band5 income is below the chosen family monthly budget.

Maintenance is accessible evidence money, not a fee or a separate duplicate budget line. 28-day hold and31-day ending window apply unless valid exception/certification. Principal certification or residence does not automatically cover newly arriving dependants.

Current family permissions normally end with actual principal/earlier parental expiry. No fresh visa term from later arrival and no guaranteed settlement in2032. Earned-settlement detail, commencement and family transitional rules remain unresolved.

No new rendering, live availability, current-law assurance, independent-model certification or external verification. Local literal/table/hash/arithmetic checks cannot certify actual eligibility, quotes or decisions.
